Skill 04 analyzed only the two same-date completed Reading Results. Q-20260901-01 yields a bounded governance judgment that capability qualification and recoverability qualification must be independent adoption gates for self-improving agents: EvoUndo reports 197 capability-positive mutations that fail recovery verification, and its mechanism binds a frozen mutation to a pre-state witness, independently derived effect surface, counterfactual states and typed observational equivalence. The Analysis explicitly preserves at-least-once control delivery, recomputation, one-machine deployment and arbitrary external side effects as limits, so it does not claim exactly-once execution.
